scientific_purpose: Controlled primary-selection experiment: hide weak-primary class labels from fits AND cuts, evaluate all known outer classes and selected-only classes; compare flat and multiplicative primary-activity gate using identical matched networks. CYP3A4
selection_rule: Prespecified primary log2fc below -0.5 from D6 coverage boundary; 20 epochs from previous duration audit. Three arms, matched splits and seeds; no historical scores or fixed call count. Gate is a testable proxy assumption, not an exact physical joint probability.
limitations: Nested held-group evaluation, all measurements excluded from fits for outer and inner holdouts. Activity targets derive only from measured primary screen, never imputed TDI labels. A4 is a selection-mechanism control; it cannot establish D6 weak-region accuracy. Conditional group bootstrap omits training and protocol-selection uncertainty. Original development outcomes have already been inspected. Synthetic masking does not replicate every source assay selection rule.
